Resolves #21386

The canvas-group witness for a failed worker load now waits as long as the engine promises. Its poll covers `CanvasGroups#startBound` (30 s, read from `src/worker/CanvasGroups.mjs`) plus 10 s instead of a 20 s literal. An annotation records which path reported the failure, `load` from the worker's `error` event or `silent` from the bound, and after how long. A late fast path on a loaded runner becomes data on a green run instead of a red build.

Intake: self-authored this session. Prescription checked: the witness (`test/playwright/e2e/core/CanvasGroupPainting.spec.mjs`) owns the concern. The engine's bound is its contract, and changing it to suit a test is an avoided trap in the ticket.

Evidence: L3 (the e2e witness in Chromium against the dev server, unmodified and with a canvas worker that loads but never answers) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: the poll's `timeout` is `START_BOUND + 10000` and its message names the bound ("… within the engine's 30000 ms start bound"). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: every passing run pushes a `canvas-start-failure` annotation. Outside-CI: 10 of 10 local runs recorded `load after 101–103 ms`. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: with root B's canvas worker pointed at an empty module (a blob URL that loads and never answers), the witness passes at head after 33.0 s with `silent after 30890 ms`, and `dev`'s witness fails after 20.9 s with "the failed group's canvas component reports its worker as unavailable", the CI failure. The unmodified witness passes 10 of 10 under `--repeat-each=10`, and the full spec passes 5 of 5. |

## Deltas from ticket

None.

## Test Evidence

The silent-worker runs are the receipt for AC-3. The mutation was one line in the witness's init script (`'/missing-canvas-worker.mjs'` → `URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([''], {type: 'text/javascript'}))`), applied to this head and to `origin/dev`'s spec and reverted after each run; it is not committed.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The witness's `canvas-start-failure` annotations on `dev`'s e2e runs show which path CI takes. `silent` there opens a `Manager` follow-up on the fast path's latency (#21386, Out of Scope).
